method: Original photograph mapped to separate facade bands. Curved roof envelope inferred from photographic shape. Source DBT footprint locates the landmark.
limitations: This is a photographic elevation study, not a scanned or measured architectural reconstruction.
Frontage photograph contains baked lighting and occluders; it is not a clean facade texture.
Layer depths, vertical photo registration and roof cross-section require measured verification.
South and end elevations are not reconstructed from this north-side photo.
